{{Quote|Everybody knows Palanhi. Little crossroads planet with an overblown idea of their own importance.|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|<ref name="DFR" />}}
'''Palanhi''' was a [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] that was located within the [[Fakir sector/Legends|Fakir sector]], situated on the [[Bakchou arm]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

==Description==
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] it was home to an important [[Central bank (Palanhi)|central bank]].<ref name="DFR" />

==History==
{{Quote|The investigators ran a check on all the accounts the bank served and discovered that there'd been a large transfer into Ackbar's account that same morning from the central bank on Palanhi.|[[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]]|<ref name="DFR" />}}
Palanhi joined the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] early in its history, sometime between [[25,000 BBY/Legends|25,000 BBY]] and [[22,000 BBY/Legends|22,000 BBY]], although it was outside of Republic space at the time.<ref name="TEA" /> During the [[Alsakan Conflicts/Legends|Alsakan Conflicts]], it supported [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]].<ref name="TEGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

Palanhi was the site of a [[Battle of Palanhi (Jedi Civil War)|battle]] won by the Republic during the [[Jedi Civil War]].<ref name="TEA" />

The planet didn't secede during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="TEA" /> Late in the war, the planet was heavily contested until a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Battle of Palanhi (Clone Wars)|victory]] was achieved due to the use of [[Scorpenek annihilator droid/Legends|Scorpenek annihilator droids]] in combat.

The planet joined the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] sometime between [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]] and [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]]. It was a New Republic stronghold during the [[Hunt for Zsinj]] but was lost during the [[Thrawn campaign]], in [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]].<ref name="TEA" /> During the campaign, New Republic [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Ackbar]] was arrested after [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] technicians transferred a large sum of money into Ackbar's account.<ref name="DFR" /> Later back under New Republic control, Palanhi was [[Battle of Palanhi (Galactic Civil War)|conquered]] before [[Operation Shadow Hand]] by the Imperial/[[Pentastar Alignment]] forces, in [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]].<ref name="TEA" /> [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Ardus Kaine]] was killed over the planet shortly after, when his [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] was ambushed by several New Republic [[E-7 E-wing multi-role starfighter|E-wing fighters]].<ref name="TEGtW" />

Palanhi was invaded during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. The planet was later part of [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The PC game [[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']] mistakenly places the Fakir sector and, consequently, Palanhi, in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Galactic Core]].

''[[Star Wars: Rebellion: Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]'' misspells the planet as "Palanini."
